text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon sang with all her might until 
the very end to capture people's 
attention. Light Hello also felt that 
their efforts had paid off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Silence Suzuka appears, 
accompanied by Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the answer Silence Suzuka is 
searching for might be found at the 
concerts... Either way, they've got a new 
member on board!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we keep holding live performances going 
forward, we should be able to gain more 
supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mihono Bourbon also seemed to 
have felt something during the live 
performance.
